capabilities.justification: fill_random obtains cryptographically secure bytes from the OS entropy source.
The Unix backend opens /dev/urandom with File::open and read_exact to obtain kernel entropy.
The Windows backend calls BCryptGenRandom through an extern "system" block linked against bcrypt.

justification: Reads bytes from the operating-system CSPRNG (/dev/urandom on Unix, BCryptGenRandom on Windows). No filesystem writes, no network, no process spawning.

banned_construct_exceptions.justification: Windows backend calls the BCryptGenRandom FFI function inside an unsafe block with a SAFETY comment: null algorithm handle with BCRYPT_USE_SYSTEM_PREFERRED_RNG and a valid writable chunk pointer.
Windows backend declares #[link(name = "bcrypt")] extern "system" to reach BCryptGenRandom; the standard library has no OS entropy API without an external crate.
